 learned counsel for the applicants.
 Shri Rajesh Tiwari, learned G.A for the respondent/State.

entities.text:
HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH  MCRC-1873-2011  (SACHIN Vs RAKESH KUMAR AHIRWAR)
 3  Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
sh This petition under section 482 of the Cr.P.C has been filed for quashment of proceeding of Criminal Case No. 2359/2009 pending e ad before the C.J.M Sagar and impugned order dated 07/09/2010 passed by 1 st Additional District and Sessions Judge, Sagar in Criminal Pr Revision No.171/2010 confirming the order dated 20/07/2010 passed a by the Judicial Magistrate First Class,
Sagar, whereby the application hy under section 468 of the Cr.P.C has been rejected.

entities.text: 1 st Additional District and Sessions Judge, Sagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
ad The brief facts giving rise to this petition are that against the applicant Food Inspector Mandla filed a complaint on 15/04/2009 that M the sample of wheat taken on 02/08/2005 was found to be adulterated of as per the report of Public Analyst dated 16/09/2005 after getting sanction order dated 28/02/2009 on the basis of application dated rt 24/12/2008 under section 7(1)/16(1)(a) of Prevention of Food ou Adulteration Act, 1954 before the CJM, Sagar and the CJM took C cognizance of the offence and proceeding of the criminal case is h pending in which on behalf of the applicant,
the application under ig section 468 of Cr.PC was filed on the ground that for the aforesaid H offence maximum punishment is 3 years and under section 368 of Cr.P.C for such cases 3 years limitation for taking cognizance is prescribed and in this case complaint has been filed after expiry of 3 years and there is nothing on record to consider any time for exclusion under section 470 of Cr.P.C but the application was rejected by the learned JMFC stating that from the date of sanction complaint has been filed within time.

entities.text: Prevention of Food ou Adulteration Act, 1954
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Apart from it, after taking cognizance the court has no jurisdiction to review its order vide order dated 20/07/2010.
Against which the revision was preferred, which was also rejected by the Revisional Court by order dated 20/09/2010, hence this petition is filed.
The ground on which the order has been assailed is that learned court below have not considered the facts and grounds in right perspective and wrongly rejected the petition.
The relevant date for consideration is the date of incident and the date on which the complaint was filed.
While learned court below have considered the date of sanction for prosecution which is irrelevant.

The period taken for the purpose of sanction may be excluded as per section 470 of Cr.P.C but in the present case application for getting sanction has been filed after the expiry of the period of the limitation.
Therefore, there is no question sh of applicability of section 470 of Cr.P.C.
Apparently cognizance has e been taken after the expiry of 3 years from the date of offence.

It is ad also apparent that nothing has been brought into the notice of the Pr learned trial court with regard to applicability of section 473 of Cr.P.C, which empowers the learned trial court to extend the period of a limitation in Sachin vs Rakesh Kumar Ahirwar on 1 February, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34835628/
1 certain cases.
Therefore the impugned orders are not hy sustainable and the proceeding of the trial court is bad as the ad complaint has been filed after the expiry of the period of limitation.

M Having considered the contentions of learned counsel for the parties and perusal of the record, in view of this Court the aforesaid of contention have a substance and apparently learned trial court has rt taken cognizance after the expiry of the period of limitation as ou prescribed under section 468 of the Cr.P.C.

The relevant date is the date of the commencement of the offence, which is 02/08/2005 and C complaint was filed on 15/04/2009 and application for sanction was h made on 24/12/2008, which is after 3 years of the incident and there ig is no other relevant facts and other circumstances in the case with H regard to the applicability of section 470 and 473 of the Cr.PC.
Therefore, the proceeding of the trial court is bad in law and it will be misuse of the process of the court and cause grave injustice with the applicant.
Hence this petition is allowed and proceeding of Criminal Case No.2359/2009 pending before the C.J.M Sagar against the applicants are quashed being time barred.
A copy of this order be sent to the learned trial court concerned for information.
Certified copy as per rules.
